Take a shelter dog out for the day in Missouri

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Missouri? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 11 shelter programs in Missouri, 8 of them open to the public. Cities include Branson, Columbia, Kansas City, Maryville, Osage Beach, Sedalia, St. Louis, Warrensburg and more.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
